verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports show vendor-specific acceleration: one user ran Ollama on an AMD RX 6650 via ROCm containers (shipped since 0.1.27), and others describe native MLX on Apple Silicon with benchmarked speedups. However, there is no first-party documentation of GPU vendor support, and another user hit a ROCm fallback-to-CPU failure. missing for 10: first-party GPU support docs, any NVIDIA/CUDA evidence, a documented AMD compatibility matrix, coverage of other vendors (e.g., Intel/Vulkan), consistent ROCm reliability.
